correctness.rationale: The exact polynomial map F(x,y)=(r x(1-x+sy), r y(1-y-sx)) has an invariant ray (x,y)=(a z,b z), a=(1+s)/(1+s²), b=(1-s)/(1+s²), on which z follows the logistic map r z(1-z). For 0<s<1, z±=(r+1±sqrt((r-3)(r+1)))/(2r) are the prime-two points for r>3 near the onset. The full 2D return multipliers are nu_parallel=4+2r-r², nu_perp=r²−2r(r+1)/d+4(r+1)/d², d=1+s². Independent exact symbolic Jacobian and two-step determinant computations reproduce both multipliers. The first possible stability/contact thresholds are r_c=1+sqrt(6), r_perp(s)=[1+sqrt((d³+3d+2)/(2-d))]/d, r_clip(s)=(1+s)/(2d)[1+sqrt(1+4d/[s(1-s)])]. The symbolic resultant of transverse -1 and clip conditions factors as (s-1)^4 d^3(s³+s²+s-1)(s³+s²+3s-1); the unique positive roots s1~0.2955977425 and s2~0.5436890127 are transverse/clip exchanges. Comparing with r_c gives s3=sqrt((2sqrt(6)-3)/5)~0.6162758288. The first event on the specified smooth interior two-cycle has ordered intervals transverse (0,s1), contact (s1,s2), transverse (s2,s3), tangent (s3,1); at equality first events tie as stated. Independently evaluated full 2D return Jacobians and sample s=.25,.4,.6,.8 confirm the order, while exact monotonicity and resultant prove the continuum. No post-event attractor or global dynamics claim is made.
